searchText: Since we renamed DepositReceipt to DepositRequest, should we rename ExecutionLayerConsolidationRequest and ExecutionLayerWithdrawalRequest to drop the EL prefix? Or should we add the prefix to DepositRequest? i.e. ExecutionLayerWithdrawalRequest -> WithdrawalRequest and ExecutionLayerConsolidationRequest -> ConsolidationRequest Good call, I personally in favour of shorter names, especially in this case as shortening doesn't seem to affect the semantics, we just drop the explicit mentioning of the EL as a source of the request I'll propose a PR https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3791
